programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: Zunächst wurde angenommen, dass Shele Danishefsky Covlin, eine erfolgreiche Finanzmanagerin in New York, 2009 durch einen Unfall in der Badewanne gestorben war. Allerdings kamen Verdachtsmomente gegen ihren entfremdeten Ehemann Roderick Covlin auf, die dazu führten, dass ihre Leiche exhumiert wurde. Dabei stellte sich heraus, dass Shele erwürgt worden war. Roderic wurde zum Hauptverdächtigen. Nach einem langwierigen Prozess wurde er für schuldig befunden und zu 25 Jahren Gefängnis für den Mord an Shele verurteilt - ein Fall, der von Habgier, Verrat und einem inszenierten Tatort geprägt war.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: 2015 wurde Ashley Melnyczok, eine 27-jährige Escortdame in Colorado Springs, von den Ex-Soldaten Joseph Kimsey und Jonathan Nelson ermordet, die es auf das Bargeld abgesehen hatten, das sie in ihrem Haus aufbewahrte. Die Tat, die ursprünglich als Einbruch geplant war, entwickelte sich zu einem brutalen Mord. Kimsey, der eine romantische Beziehung zu Melnyczok hatte, und Nelson, der Kimsey im Gefängnis kennengelernt hatte, wurden wegen Mordes ersten Grades verurteilt. Ihr Prozess offenbarte eine Mischung aus persönlichen und finanziellen Motiven sowie einen schweren Mangel an Empathie.

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Die Polizei fand die nackten Leichen von drei Frauen, die erschossen und in abgelegenen Gebieten außerhalb von Daytona Beach zurückgelassen worden waren. Es war ein Serienmörder am Werk. Der Fall blieb fast ein Jahrzehnt lang ungelöst, bis die Entdeckung eines vierten weiblichen Opfers forensische DNA-Spuren lieferte, die die Ermittler zu einem unvorhergesehenen Mörder führten.

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Shanti Cooper-Tronnes wurde tot in der Badewanne aufgefunden, eine Woche bevor ihr Haus für eine Renovierungssendung im Fernsehen ausgewählt wurde. Ihr Ehemann David behauptete, es handele sich um einen Unfall, doch die Ermittler deckten eine Geschichte voller Lügen und Täuschungen auf.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Der Polizeihund "Cisco" rückt zu einem Einbruch an einem Ort aus, den man am allerwenigsten erwarten würde - der Loge des Berufsverbands der Polizei. Unterdessen wird der Polizeihund "Karma" gegen einen aggressiven Verdächtigen eingesetzt, der sich der Festnahme widersetzt. Nachdem sein Hundeführer von einem Fahrzeug angefahren wurde, setzt der Polizeihund "Jakko" die Verfolgung allein fort und nimmt die Fährte eines bewaffneten Verdächtigen auf. Als der Polizeihund "Mickey" den Verdächtigen schließlich zu Boden bringt, zahlt er dafür einen schmerzhaften Preis.

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle
programme.desc: Im ländlichen Florida wurde eine schwangere junge Frau mit dem Gesicht nach unten am Straßenrand gefunden - mit einem Schädelbruch und aufgeschlitzter Kehle. programme.title: Crime in Progress - Verbrechen in Echtzeit

programme.title: Die Psyche eines Mörders
programme.desc: Jahrelang misshandelte der beliebte TikTok-Star Ali Abulaban seine Frau Ana. Als sie ihn schließlich verließ, reagierte er darauf voller Wut. Er installierte Spionagesoftware auf dem Tablet ihrer Tochter und erschoss sie und ihren Freund Ray in San Diego.

programme.title: Cops Who Kill - Mörder in Uniform
programme.desc: Die Entführung, Vergewaltigung und Ermordung der 33-jährigen Sarah Everard im Jahr 2021 erschütterte Großbritannien. programme.desc: In Tulsa folgen Ermittler einer Blutspur bis in eine Wohnsiedlung, wo die Anschuldi-gungen einer Person tödliche Folgen haben. In Mobile eskaliert eine mögliche Kollision zwischen zwei Fremden zu einer tödlichen Schießerei.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: Im Jahr 2015 plante Samantha Nicole Wohlford zusammen mit Johnathan Kyle Sanford, Jose Antonio Ponse und Octavious Lamar Rhymes die Entführung und Ermordung ihres Ehemanns Ernest "Ernie" Lee Ibarra jr. in Mount Pleasant, Texas. Samantha inszenierte den Überfall zunächst als Einbruch, doch ihr Plan sah vor, Ernie zu schlagen, zu entführen und ihm schließlich in den Hinterkopf zu schießen. Ihre widersprüchlichen Erzählungen und Beweise führten zu ihrer Verhaftung. Samantha und ihre Mitverschwörer wurden alle für schuldig befunden und erhielten lange Haftstrafen.

programme.title: Imperfect Murder - Die Fehler eines Mörders
programme.desc: David Ford, ein Polizeibeamter aus Lebanon in Kentucky, und seine Frau Tonya Ford führten ein scheinbar normales Leben, bis sich im Februar 2009 etwas Schockierendes ereignete. David wurde in ihrem Haus erschossen aufgefunden, wodurch Tonya als Hauptverdächtige in den Fokus geriet. Die Ermittlungen ergaben Spannungen in ihrer Ehe, eine Affäre und, dass die Partnerschaft, von der man dachte, sie hätten sie gehabt, nur noch eine ferne Erinnerung war. Dies führte zu dem Verdacht, dass Tonya an Davids Tod beteiligt war. 2011 wurde Tonya wegen Mordes an ihrem Ehemann angeklagt und verurteilt.

programme.title: Cold Case Files - Beweismittel DNA
programme.desc: Nachdem die 14-jährige Nacole Smith 1995 auf einem Waldweg in Atlanta brutal ermordet wurde, unterstützen die Polizei und die Gemeinde ihre Mutter bei der Suche nach Gerechtigkeit. Erst Jahrzehnte später, nach einem zweiten brutalen Überfall, kann der Mörder von Nacole endlich identifiziert werden.

programme.title: Cold Case Files - Beweismittel DNA
programme.desc: Als die 30-jährige Susan Woods verprügelt und ertränkt in ihrer Badewanne in Amerikas Cowboy-Hauptstadt aufgefunden wird, fällt der Verdacht auf ihren entfremdeten Ehemann. Mit der DNA eines Verdächtigen in der Tasche gehen die Ermittler zurück zu den Anfängen, um einen Killer-Cowboy zu entlarven, der unerkannt vor aller Augen lebt.

programme.title: Taskforce Kinderschutz - Verbrechen im Netz
programme.desc: Als ein Sexualstraftäter plant, sich mit einer 13-Jährigen im Einkaufszentrum zu treffen, versucht Detective Tony Godwin, seine schnellste Festnahme aller Zeiten durchzuführen. Dann führt eine Spur des FBI zu einem Haus und zwei Verdächtigen. Das abartige Geheimnis eines Sexualstraftäters wird in einem Müllcontainer einer Kirche entdeckt.

Anschließend schließen sich die Ermittler zusammen, um einen Sexualstraftäter auf frischer Tat zu ertappen. Unterdessen wird "Clooney" eingesetzt, als ein Verdächtiger versucht, einen Polizeiwagen zu stehlen, um in einem letzten verzweifelten Versuch zu fliehen. Während eines heftigen Kampfes ist der Hundeführer von "Bane" gezwungen, ihn mithilfe einer automatischen Türentriegelung für schnelle Einsätze ferngesteuert einzusetzen. Und "Mari" spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei einer der größten Kokainbeschlagnahmungen in ihrer Region.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Paris"
programme.desc: Using a virtual scalpel, CGI strips the Eiffel Tower to its 17-foot base and peels back the boulevards to expose 180 miles of ancient quarries.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Machu Picchu"
programme.desc: CGI animation dismantles this ancient mountain city, uncovering the genius Incan terraces, drainage systems, and stonework that survive seismic shifts

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Los Angeles is stripped to its bones, revealing the high-tech base isolators, fault-line monitoring, and infrastructure built to survive the Big One.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Roads That Changed The World"
programme.desc: Chariots were the express vehicles of their day – but how did they work? And what about the roads, tunnels, and bridges that they relied upon?

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "The Great Wall of China"
programme.desc: Since the earliest civilizations, humans have needed walls to protect them.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of The Pyramids"
programme.desc: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only survivor of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Its scale is breath-taking and it is built to precision.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Rise Of The Super-Castle"
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, the technology of the castle evolved by leaps and bounds.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Predicting A Pro"
programme.desc: Increasingly high-tech tools are being used to evaluate youth baseball players. The question is can they outperform professional scouts?

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Rebirth of an Underwater Forest"
programme.desc: Kelp forests harbor a higher diversity of plants and animals than almost any other ocean community. But, what happens when this ecosystem is out of balance?

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Sailing to the Stars"
programme.desc: Solar sails, the latest in space travel technology, could one day help us reach nearby stars. Follow the exciting missions laying the ground towards a new form of space exploration.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Bear Cub Rescue"
programme.desc: Growing up in Montana, Casey Anderson come to love and appreciate wild animals at a very young age. He found a particular kinship with bears. One day he was faced with a fateful decision, leave and orphaned grizzly cub to die in the wild or save it.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Royal Clipper"
programme.desc: Engineers use modern hydraulics to sail the world’s largest square-rigged ship while keeping high-end cruise guests comfortable.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Saipem 7000"
programme.desc: The world's second-largest crane vessel faces tense delays and closing weather during a multi-million-dollar oil rig job.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Algoma Bulk Freighter"
programme.desc: A huge cargo ship battles lake waves and ice to move grain and iron ore, navigating a seven-flight lock past Niagara Falls.

programme.title: Monster Ships S1 - "Pacific Orca"
programme.desc: A unique wind-turbine installation ship lifts its hull out of the water while facing violent seas and high winds.

programme.title: How the Universe Works S2 - "The Furnaces of Life"
programme.desc: Volcanoes discovered on alien worlds across space reveal active geology and potential environments for extraterrestrial life.

programme.title: How the Universe Works S2 - "The Winds of Creation"
programme.desc: Monstrous megastorms and chaotic weather across distant planets could spark the conditions needed for alien life to flourish.

programme.title: How the Universe Works S2 - "Planets from Hell"
programme.desc: Astronomers explore extreme exoplanets outside our solar system, uncovering terrifying cosmic environments.

programme.title: How the Universe Works S2 - "Cosmic Firestorms"
programme.desc: Powerful solar flares and cosmic magnetic storms pose a threat to surrounding worlds across the universe.

programme.title: How the Universe Works S2 - "Clockwork and Creation"
programme.desc: Planetary orbits range from chaotic destruction to cosmic forces that help shape the structure of the universe.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Student-Astronaut Contest"
programme.desc: One lucky student wins the prize of going to Hawaii and experience the HI-SEAS habitat. Host Emily Calandrelli joins the contest winner in this special episode.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Mission to Mars: The InSight Lander"
programme.desc: The InSight Lander is on its way to Mars. Host Emily Calandrelli discovers what it takes to prepare this spacecraft for its mission.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Space Oddities"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli speaks to two experts about the most fascinating facts about our universe.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Future of Space Medicine"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli explores the future of space medicine and how we may overcome the challenges ahead.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "Biomimicry/Mechanimals"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he explores how designers are using Manta Rays to change the way we explore the ocean’s depths.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "Robots For Hire"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he talks to astronauts, designers and factory workers as they describe how the robotic revolution is affecting the way we work.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "The Future of Food"
programme.desc: Host Joe Penna talks to the people who are creating the foods of the future and samples everything from test tube beef to edible insects.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S1 - "They Cyborgs Are Coming"
programme.desc: Join host Joe Penna as he discovers a search and rescue robot that doubles as a tank, cuddles a therapy robot designed to look, and act, like an actual pet, and tests a high tech fireman’s mask that has a lot more than X-ray vision.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Rising Tides"
programme.desc: The next generation of Earth observation satellites are now in place maintaining the continuity of long-term climate data. Scientists are concerned the rate is increasing beyond expectations and glacier melting continues unabated.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Earths Evil Twin"
programme.desc: Venus once may have been as hospitable to life as Earth is now. Then something changed and Venus became shrouded in hot dense toxic clouds. There are now plans to send advanced probes to the surface of Venus and find out what happened to our twin.

programme.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Increasing Orbit"
programme.desc: The ISS is the workhorse of the international spacefaring community, but its days are numbered. Replacement space stations are on the drawing board. However, with commercial interests these stations will add tourism and manufacturing to the mix.

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Who’s the Smartest in the Room?"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. Where’s the hottest place in North America? Does a camel’s hump store water or fat? Our planet is moving through space at 67,000 mph, so why don’t we feel it moving?

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Dare to be Smart"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. When was the first virtual-reality headset created? What is hydroponic farming? What’s the difference between a grizzly bear and a brown bear?

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci Smarts"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. What’s the name of the largest fault line in California? How does the Venus Flytrap catch bugs? Is the far side of the moon always dark?

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci Quiz"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. How long can a person exist without water? How fast is the International Space Station travelling through space? What exactly are DNA Forensics?

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Double-Barreled Cannon"
programme.desc: Today we will resurrect a cannon used in the American Civil War.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Davis Life Pod"
programme.desc: Today we will try an invention that can save lives at sea.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "Syrian Torpedo"
programme.desc: Today we will see what happens when you combine traditional blacksmithing, gunpowder and water.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S3 - "The Bourne Submarine"
programme.desc: Today we will see if it is possible to make an old-school wooden submarine under water and above all back on the surface.

programme.title: Extremes S1 - "Tall Buildings, Fast Animals and Expensive Cities"
programme.desc: In this episode of Extremes, we explore tall buildings, fast animals, expensive cities and extremely impressive basketball records.

programme.title: Extremes S1 - "Long Lives, Destructive Weather and Speed Records"
programme.desc: In this episode of Extremes, you will learn about extreme close-up photography, long lives, destructive weather and speed records.

programme.title: Extremes S1 - "Physics, Space and Wealth"
programme.desc: In this episode of Extremes, we’ll explore all things extreme in physics, space and wealth plus take a look at the smallest creatures on Earth.

programme.title: Extremes S1 - "Largest Animals, Human Bodies and Football"
programme.desc: In this episode of Extremes, we will be exploring the largest animals, extreme facts about the human body and record breaking extremes in football and the field of music.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Across Oceans"
programme.desc: Throughout history, human society has run on trade. The innovations that allowed faster and more accurate oceanic travel revolutionized the world. New inventions now help people and goods move on the water faster for recreation and commerce.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Across Continents"
programme.desc: Never in the history of humanity have so many of us been mobile. New innovations propel us into the world of self-driving cars and high-speed trains.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into the Skies"
programme.desc: Growth in air transportation is set to soar, carrying over 10 billion passengers every year by 2050. To cope requires us to radically rethink aircraft design. Join us as we look into the world's most innovative research and development labs.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Into Space"
programme.desc: The most innovative area of human motion lies not on Earth, but with the exploration of space. Meet the private space entrepreneurs jostling to offer the tantalizing prospect of cheap, frequent travel beyond the atmosphere into Earth orbit.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Coronavirus: Don't Blame Bats"
programme.desc: Bats are getting their share of the blame for the COVID-19 pandemic, but are they really at fault?

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Peru's Mysterious Cloud Warriors"
programme.desc: Archeologists and geneticists are uncovering surprising details about one of the most mysterious civilizatiions in Pre-Incan South America.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Decoding Megalodon"
programme.desc: Scientists have concluded that "meg" was able to achieve its gargantuan proportions by starting its carnivorous diet early -- in the womb.

programme.title: Singapore's Field Of Dreams
programme.desc: Follow the construction of Singapore’s billion-dollar sports hub, featuring a 55,000-seat stadium with a groundbreaking retractable domed roof.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Museums and Galleries: Architectural Treasures"
programme.desc: Bilbao, Amsterdam, Antwerp and Florence belong to a dynamic group of cities that preserve the heritage of humanity through museums.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "TV Towers: Complex and Gracious"
programme.desc: Television towers are a distinctive type of structure that have long transcended the utilitarian purpose they were designed for.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Skid Row"
programme.desc: The drought means the monkey troop are facing starvation, but they are saved in the nick of time when a devout Hindu brings them bagful’s of fruit and treats.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Operations Wild Dog"
programme.desc: Almost fully grown now, the wild dogs are Marlice’s prized project and biggest responsibility - when one gets bitten by a snake, they move quickly to save her.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Cheetah Rescue"
programme.desc: A caracal with a broken leg arrives needing immediate medical attention. When the owner of two tame cheetahs also breaks a leg, Marlice must rescue them as well.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Tooth Trouble & Game Count"
programme.desc: With all the rain came an abundance of animals - to count them Rudie takes to the air, but only after saving a cheetah’s life on the operating table.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Preparing for the Big Release"
programme.desc: In their biggest effort to release animals back into the wild - Marlice and Rudie must dart and capture seven cheetahs and one leopard - all in one day.

programme.title: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "The Big Release"
programme.desc: Seven cheetahs and one leopard get their first taste of freedom in an epic release effort - one that Marlice and Rudie have been dreaming about.

programme.title: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Accidents, Surgeries and Fearful Friends"
programme.desc: The team springs into action for a a puppy hit by car, Westie's unusual surgery and a Staffordshire that fears fireworks.

programme.title: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Lumps, Jabs and Tiny Patients"
programme.desc: The team treats Labrador Scuby’s lumps, nervous cat Wotzit’s jabs, rescue collie Bob, and tiny rat Squeaky’s stomach growth in a day of unusual cases.

programme.title: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Paws, Gums and Urgent Care"
programme.desc: Team faces a day of critical animal care with plus-size cat Bob to Angus’s gum surgery, a Husky’s sore paw, and Bandit’s urgent bladder operation.

programme.title: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Kittens, Puppies and Senior Paws"
programme.desc: Debbie cares for abandoned kittens, vets neuter Chihuahua pups,Sonia brings in senior Bichon Mitch, and the mobile clinic checks over playful puppies.

programme.title: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Bladders, Knees and Rescue Tales"
programme.desc: The team tackles a dog with bladder issues, a delicate knee operation, diabetes checks for a blind Husky, and urgent care for a stray cat in need.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "The Jura Mountains"
programme.desc: The ibex, marmot, and European adder have all developed strategies to survive the alpine winter.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "Ticino"
programme.desc: Learn about four different regions of Switzerland. From the rugged mountains of the Ticino High Alps to the lovely Muggio Valley in the southernmost corner of Ticino, hardly any other canton is so full of contrasts.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland S1 - "Water and Ice"
programme.desc: The river called Aare is the only body of water that runs through Switzerland. It rises from a source in the Bernese Alps and finally flows into the Rhine. The Aere offers an important habitat for flora and fauna.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Elephants"
programme.desc: Can the African elephant evers be tamed? Is it possible to sustain an entire tourism industry based on them being domesticated? Swati walks with the elephants of Knysna park while these questions are asked.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Coronavirus: Don't Blame Bats"
programme.desc: Bats are getting their share of the blame for the COVID-19 pandemic, but are they really at fault?

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "A Taste of Life Part 1"

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "A Taste of Life Part 2"

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Adaptation"

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Superfoods"
programme.desc: The high altitude environment makes foods that are considered "super". From quinoa, to special beans and salt - We travel from the Uyuni Salt flats back to La Paz to work with a Master Chef.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "T-28"
programme.desc: Profiling the U.S. Air Force and Navy training aircraft that also was flown during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Aviaton Career Choices"
programme.desc: Anthony visits the University of North Dakota to learn some of the many other ways to make a living in the world of aviation besides being an airline pilot.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Start up and Run Up"
programme.desc: Sara and Anthony run the checklists with us as we look at all the steps pilots take on the ground to make sure things go as planned in the air.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "John Mohr, Barnstormer & T-45 Goshawk"
programme.desc: We get to know the man who flies a stock 1947 Stearman like no one else on the planet & explore the aircraft that introduces fighter pilots to carrier landings.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: Secluded for many centuries in inaccessible valleys, the inhabitants of the Alps had no alternative but to rely on the healing powers of nature. A knowledge of herbs was deeply rooted in these mountain-dwellers’ everyday lives – until the twentieth century, when this wisdom became eclipsed by modern academic medicine. Today, Alpine herbs are witnessing a revival, as public interest in regional natural treasures grows. The potential of Alpine herbs is far from exhausted. In the Berchtesgaden Alps, the film shows Hubsi Ilsanker at work as a root-digger, a back-breaking job that has scarcely changed in four hundred years. Authorized by a special historic permit to supply the oldest gentian distillery in Germany, Hubsi digs for protected gentian roots in Berchtesgaden National Park. For yellow gentian is one of the most bitter medicinal herbs in the world, well suited for schnapps and as a general tonic.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: In the pristine nature and mild climate of southeastern Europe grows a unique diversity of wild plants. Far removed from major industry and polluted soils, the Balkan countries have become the largest exporter of herbs in Europe. In Bulgaria alone, more than 300,000 people work with domestic plants. The business is becoming increasingly lucrative. The film takes us to the Croatian coast. On the Adriatic island of Cres, the audience meets Mladen Dragoslavić. In May, when the sage begins to blossom, this beekeeper has one month to produce his income for an entire year – always with the goal of creating the best sage honey in the Balkans. Given a choice, the bees would never choose sage, for entering and exiting the narrow blossom is strenuous. Within three weeks, maximum, Mladen must remove his bees from the island. Otherwise they will die of exhaustion. In Skopje, the capital of Macedonia, the film visits Iva Yosifova. Hollyhock provides the raw material for her objects of art. The herb is medically beneficial, due to its mucilage, which is added to many cough tea mixtures. Iva, though, makes paper from hollyhock. Thanks to the herb’s long fibres, the paper can be spread onto objects and modeled. The technique produces delicate sculptures, as fragile as nature.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Europe's Wild River - The Elbe - 1.000 Miles of Wildlife and Nature
programme.desc: The river rises in the Czech Giant Mountains. Here it is called the Labe. After Děčín it flows into Germany and is called Elbe. There are various explanations for the origin of the river name "Elbe". One often mentioned is the Latin name of the river "albia", which means "bright water". This would also explain why the stream is referred to with the feminine article "the Elbe", since the Latin term "albia" is also feminine. Rather poetic than linguistically probable, however, is the explanation that elves (Middle High German: alb) scurrying around the pines in the white river mists could have helped the river to get its name. Geographically, the river can be divided into different sections: The Upper Elbe is the part from the source to about Riesa in the administrative district of Dresden, which is more characterized by mountains. The Middle Elbe, on the other hand, is a lowland river. It reaches as far as the Geesthacht dam just outside Hamburg. The Lower Elbe is called the tidal part of the river. Here, the Elbe forms an estuary, a so-called estuary. At high tide, seawater enters this funnel-shaped delta at the mouth of the Elbe and mixes with the freshwater of the river. At low tide, the water then flows off to the North Sea. Finally, the continuation of the estuary funnel in the Wadden Sea is called the Outer Elbe.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: Texas Rangers and long-time ranching partners Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call meet their old friend Jake, and decide to strike out from their south Texas base and drive a cattle herd to Montana.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: McCrae and Wood's cattle drive faces deadly situations. Sheriff July Johnson heads to Texas, and former prostitute Lorena is abandoned by Jake and kidnapped by the psychotic Blue Duck.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: Gus and July save Lorena from Blue Duck, but at a deadly cost. Jake runs with a bad crowd and pays the price. July accepts that his wife has left him and stays on at Clara's with his newborn son.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: The cattle drive reaches Nebraska, where Gus and Clara reunite. Drought and Indian attacks take their toll as the drive reaches Montana, and Gus is wounded. Call honors his best friend's request.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: Acclaimed director Franco Zeffirelli and an all-star cast come together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth.
